definitions.gloss: internal; in-house; relating to the inside of an organization or system
definitions.explanation: Describes something confined to the inside of an organization, group, system, or entity — as opposed to being external or public. Commonly used in business, legal, and technical writing to contrast with {外部的|がいぶてき} ('external').

examples.japanese: {内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
{内部的|ないぶてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処理|しょり}して→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ものです。
examples.english: This matter is due to internal circumstances of the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねた→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: The government reached a final decision after repeated internal deliberations.

notes:
A na-adjective formed by attaching the suffix {〜的|てき} ('-ic; pertaining to') to ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧ ('interior; inside; the internal part'). It marks something as belonging to the internal sphere of an organization, system, or entity.

USAGE:
Strong bias toward formal, written, or business contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (using the noun directly with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) is often more natural; {内部的|ないぶてき} adds an abstract, categorical nuance ('of the internal kind').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: an internal issue
- {内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: internal circumstances
- {内部的|ないぶてき}⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧: internal factor
- {内部的|ないぶてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to handle internally
- {内部的|ないぶてき}⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: internal conflict
- {内部的|ないぶてき}⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧: in-house review

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧: interior; inside — noun; used as ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧: within the company — more specific, corporate
- ⟦{内|うち}{向|む}き→内向き：26799_uchimuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: inward-facing — suggests closed-off attitude rather than category
- {外部的|がいぶてき}: external — the direct antonym

CONTRAST WITH {内部|ないぶ}の:
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: an internal problem (concrete, factual)
- {内部的|ないぶてき}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: an internal-type problem (categorical, often contrasted with external)
The difference is subtle, but {〜的|てき} adds an abstract, classifying feel suitable for formal analysis.
